newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED RAISE BID FOR BABBEL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED RAISE BID FOR BABBEL.

text.p: Manchester United have raised their offer for Markus Babbel to 2.8 million marks ($1.6 million) per year after the Bayern Munich defender rejected an earlier bid of 1.75 million marks, the German news agency SID said on Friday.

Talks between Babbel and Manchester United stalled on Monday when Babbel said he wanted four million marks per year but Manchester United were able to increase their offer after failing to sign Danish international Brian Laudrup from Glasgow
